description: This file manages the configuration and administrative functions related to taxes within the vtiger CRM system, including retrieving, updating, adding, enabling/disabling, and labeling tax types, as well as handling shipping and handling taxes.

methods.name: updateTaxPercentages
methods.description: Updates the list of tax percentages for specified tax types, optionally for shipping and handling taxes.

methods.name: updateTaxLabels
methods.description: Updates the labels of specified tax types, checking for duplicates before updating.

methods.name: addTaxType
methods.description: Adds a new tax type, altering related tables to include the new tax as a column.

methods.name: changeDeleted
methods.description: Enables or disables a tax type by setting its 'deleted' status.
